hooks.command: p=$(cat); case "$p" in *sf-*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; run() { printf %s "$p" | "$@" agents outcome capture --host codex >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; }; for c in "$d/node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai" "$d/node_modules/.bin/sf"; do [ -x "$c" ] && run "$c"; done; [ -f "$d/bin/sf.js" ] && grep -q '"name": "saasfoundryai-cli"' "$d/package.json" 2>/dev/null && run node "$d/bin/sf.js"; command -v saasfoundryai >/dev/null 2>&1 && run saasfoundryai; exit 0
